# pylimer-tools

> pylimer-tools is a Python and C++ toolkit for simulating, analyzing, and handling bead-spring polymer networks and LAMMPS molecular dynamics output (Monte Carlo network generation, DPD simulations with slip-springs, implicit Rouse and Brownian dynamics, Maximum Entropy Homogenization / Force Balance, normal mode analysis, and topological resistance distance & network structure analysis).


2021-2026, Tim Bernhard
